children: Malaysia's August palm oil stocks rose 7.48% from the previous month to 2.82 million metric tons, data from the industry regulator showed on Thursday.
Crude palm oil production gained 1.39% from July to reach 1.82 million tons, while palm oil exports dropped 7.5% to 1.29 million tons, the Malaysian Palm Oil Board said.
A Reuters survey had forecast August inventories at 2.76 million tons, with output seen at 1.82 million tons and exports at 1.32 million tons. PALM/POLL
